missing_inputs: workflow governance confirmation that CLAUDE.md modification is an authorized governed action
checked_items.reason: CLAUDE.md §15 requires all governed actions to be subject to orchestration-based workflow enforcement. Modifying it without an established authority chain creates a runtime governance gap: the enforcement document could be silently altered, invalidating all downstream governance. This is a doc-runtime drift: the document's own governance rules would be violated by the modification process.
